headerDisplay: Controls a Samsung room air conditioner over its local network API. Add each unit's IP address below, then pair it from the card above — pairing needs the unit powered off and back on, so it cannot be done from this form alone.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Home app. Leave empty to use the name the unit reports.

host.title: IP address
host.description: The unit's address on your network. Give it a fixed DHCP lease on your router — the plugin cannot follow it if it moves.

token.title: Device token (optional)
token.description: Only needed if you paired outside this plugin. Leave empty and use Pair above; tokens paired there are stored outside config.json.

heating.title: Heating
heating.description: Samsung units under-report what they support: the reference unit leaves Heat out of its mode list even while it is heating. Detection reads the unit's rated heating capacity instead, which is right for every unit seen so far. Set this only if the Home app offers a Heat button that does nothing, or hides one that should work.

updateInterval.title: Status poll interval (seconds)
updateInterval.description: How often to read the unit. This is a local network request, so it can be frequent.

swingDirection.title: Swing direction
swingDirection.description: What to set the vane to when swing is switched on in HomeKit. On a TP6X_RAC_16K only Up_And_Low works: Vertical and SwingUD are rejected outright, and All is accepted and then ignored. The others are kept for units that differ; the log says if yours refuses the one you pick.

outdoorTemperature.title: Outdoor temperature sensor

oneOf.title: Show it — unit reports Fahrenheit (confirmed on TP6X_RAC_16K)

outdoorTemperature.description: Publishes the unit's outdoor sensor as a temperature tile of its own. Which scale it is in is stated nowhere in what the unit reports, and is independent of the unit's own setting: a TP6X_RAC_16K reports itself in Celsius and this in Fahrenheit, measured against a known outdoor temperature. Fahrenheit is the default for that reason. If your tile reads far too cold, your unit reports Celsius here — switch it.

certificateUrl.title: Client certificate URL
certificateUrl.description: Advanced. Where to download the Samsung client certificate from. Change this only if you mirror it yourself.
